copy.title: 5 things to try between tasks instead of scrolling
1. remove the color
copy.body: try grayscale when a quick check keeps becoming a long one.

copy.title: 2. stop the little nudges
copy.body: turn off notifications that do not need an answer today.

copy.title: 3. park the charger elsewhere
copy.body: keep the phone away from the spot where you take breaks.

copy.title: 4. turn a walk into earnit minutes
5. decide what your break is for
copy.body: water, a stretch, a window. pick one before unlocking. save this.
